name: 08087 · Ltl Egg Hbr, NJ
findings: ZIP 08087 (Ltl Egg Hbr) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08087 (Ltl Egg Hbr) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08087 (Ltl Egg Hbr) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
